title: A full-stack app has a race condition that only appears under heavy load. How do you debug it?
description: Use load testing, distributed tracing, and concurrency analysis to isolate race conditions.

data.text: **Question:** A full-stack app has a race condition that only appears under heavy load. How do you debug it?
Use load testing to reproduce the issue, add structured logging with correlation IDs, and inspect shared state in database and caches. Look for missing transactions or optimistic concurrency checks.

items: Reproduce with a load test tool (k6, JMeter, or Visual Studio Load Test)
Trace requests across services with correlation IDs
Check database for dirty reads or lost updates
Review async code for missing awaits or shared mutable state
Use pessimistic or optimistic concurrency tokens

data.text: They want to see that you can reproduce intermittent bugs, instrument code, and apply concurrency controls.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Apply concurrency tokens at the data layer
Measure impact of any fix under load
